component.name: FontTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" end sub
sub runTask() lbl = m.top.target lbl.font = invalid print "PROBE|task|Label.font|invalid|value=" + describeFont(lbl.font) lbl.font = "font:NoSuchFont" print "PROBE|task|Label.font|font:NoSuchFont|value=" + describeFont(lbl.font) ' A Label the Task creates is owned by the Task thread, so these writes stay on it. own = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") own.text = "task owned" cases = [ { name: "invalid", value: invalid }, { name: "font:NoSuchFont", value: "font:NoSuchFont" }, { name: "string-garbage", value: "garbage" }, { name: "string-empty", value: "" }, { name: "node-Rectangle", value: CreateObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") }, { name: "integer-5", value: 5 }, ] for each c in cases own.font = "font:LargeBoldSystemFont" own.font = c.value print "PROBE|task-owned|Label.font|" + c.name + "|value=" + describeFont(own.font) own.font = "font:LargeBoldSystemFont" ok = own.setField("font", c.value) print "PROBE|task-owned|Label.font|setField-" + c.name + "|ret=" + ok.toStr() + "|value=" + describeFont(own.font) end for m.top.done = true end sub
function describeFont(v as dynamic) as string if v = invalid then return "invalid" if type(v) <> "roSGNode" then return type(v) return v.subtype() + "(uri=" + v.uri + ",size=" + v.size.toStr() + ")" end function
